On a2295a64, before, each seat's sweeps plinked on every seed 1-5; main 0. Bodies of his that are no fight's dying beside alpha's sweeps are a guardrail, not a separator (the pre-fix build kills as many): 22-32 on main seeds 1-5, bound about 30% under the least, 22 x 0.7 = 15, so a sweep that never strikes fails
